summary: Frontend-only end-to-end testing of CDM Acqua & Relax one-page marketing site. All 19 review_request checkpoints verified successfully on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). No JavaScript console errors detected.

test_results.page_loads: PASS - Site loads at https://riposo-puro-italia.preview.emergentagent.com without console errors
test_results.header_nav: PASS - Sticky glassmorphism header with all 7 nav links visible (nav-home, nav-acqua, nav-relax, nav-poltrone, nav-chiSiamo, nav-showroom, nav-contatti)
test_results.language_switcher: PASS - lang-it / lang-en toggle works. Hero changes 'Acqua pura.' -> 'Pure water.' and back to IT correctly. localStorage persistence via LangContext.
test_results.hero_section: PASS - hero-section visible, hero-cta-primary (href=#contatti), hero-cta-secondary (href=#acqua), 3 trust badges (hero-trust-0..2) all visible.
test_results.water_section: PASS - 8 water-benefit-0..7, water-cta-card, water-before-after, water-visual-comparison all present. CTA link inside water-cta-card resolves to https://wa.me/3533923263?text=... (correct WhatsApp number).
test_results.relax_section: PASS - 8 relax-feature-0..7 and 4 relax-product-0..3 rendered with 'immagine prova' placeholder labels (10 placeholders total counted across site).
test_results.showroom_section: PASS - Google Maps iframe embedded (1 iframe count), 8 tel: links and 7 mailto: links across page.
test_results.reviews_section: PASS - 3 review cards (review-card-0..2). Note: each card contains 6 SVG icons (5 stars + 1 likely decorative quote icon).
test_results.faq_accordion: PASS - Clicking faq-trigger-1 after faq-trigger-0 results in trigger-0 aria-expanded=false and trigger-1 aria-expanded=true, confirming single-open accordion behavior closes previous item.
test_results.contact_section_ctas: PASS - contact-cta-email -> mailto:info@cdmacquaerelax.it..., contact-cta-whatsapp -> https://wa.me/3533923263?text=..., contact-cta-phone -> tel:+393716250300
test_results.footer: PASS - Footer renders with brand info, nav links, addresses, phone, email links.
test_results.whatsapp_floating_button: PASS - whatsapp-floating-btn appears after scroll, links to https://wa.me/3533923263?text=...
test_results.mobile_responsive: PASS - At 390x844 viewport, mobile-menu-trigger visible. Clicking opens menu showing all 7 nav links + Consulenza gratuita + WhatsApp CTAs + hero CTAs.
test_results.console_errors: PASS - 0 console errors during full interaction flow.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend has default /api/status routes from template but is intentionally unused per user requirement (no contact form). Consider removing the unused MongoDB/StatusCheck boilerplate if it remains in /app/backend/server.py to reduce attack surface.
All interactive elements properly expose data-testid attributes (excellent testability).
i18n IT<->EN toggle is implemented cleanly via LangContext with localStorage persistence.
WhatsApp number 3533923263 is correctly used across all CTAs (water, contact, floating button).
test_credentials: N/A - public marketing site, no auth
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site is a one-page marketing site (Italian default + English toggle). No backend forms - all conversions go to wa.me/3533923263, mailto:info@cdmacquaerelax.it, or tel:+393716250300. All 19 review_request features were verified end-to-end via Playwright on desktop and mobile viewports with zero defects and zero console errors. If future changes are made, re-run the same Playwright flow against the data-testid attributes (see /app/frontend/src/components/*.jsx).
